title: feat: connect polli's Claude Code harness directly to gen's /v1/messages
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Connects Claude Code directly to gen’s `/v1/messages` (#15680), removing Claude Code Router and its broken credential handoff.
- Writes a separate `~/.pollinations/claude-code.json` with the dedicated key and model aliases. Launch with `claude --settings ~/.pollinations/claude-code.json`; native Claude login/settings stay untouched. `off` deletes only this file.
- Runs Claude Code itself for readiness, verifies dedicated-key usage, and restores the previous file on failure. Bumps `@pollinations/cli` to **0.1.24**.
- Removes CCR from the E2B template. Rebuild the template after 0.1.24 is published; no template rebuild is included here.
- Verified after updating with main: **282 CLI tests**, build, lint and shell syntax pass. Installed Claude Code 2.1.289 passed isolated setup/status/off, key reuse, rollback, streaming and Read-tool tests. A live Pollinations Read-tool round trip with `openai/gpt-6-sol` also passed.

Original implementation session: https://claude.ai/code/session_011LgiC2X1edxD4TcXeX9sXo

gist.headline: Polli takes the direct route
gist.blurb: Polli’s Claude Code harness takes a straight path to gen’s `/v1/messages`. No router in the middle, and Claude’s own settings stay put.
gist.summary: `@pollinations/cli` 0.1.24 connects Claude Code directly to gen’s `/v1/messages`, replacing Claude Code Router with a dedicated `~/.pollinations/claude-code.json` that preserves native Claude settings and rolls back if setup fails.
gist.impact: Claude Code launches with Pollinations credentials and model aliases from a separate settings file; `off` removes only that file, while setup checks that Claude Code actually uses the dedicated key.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli guiding a small Claude Code terminal along a direct garden path to a glowing /v1/messages endpoint, with an unused router sign off to the side. A separate settings card beside the path represents the dedicated configuration; a nearby untouched terminal represents native Claude settings.
